question: From which country has the idea of ​​rule of law in the Indian Constitution been taken?
solution:
The correct answer is __**United Kingdom**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The concept of rule of law was adapted from British common law and is enshrined in the Indian Constitution. 
 
• The rule of law means that no one is above the law, including the government.
